title: Cute but…
text: This is pretty cute for the younger kids. My 9 year old was excited at first, but he has done so many of the free coding things offered by a popular game that he, and many other kids, play that this just wasn’t up to snuff for him. He received box 3 or 4 today (the one with kings, queens, and unicorns) and he asked me if we can look into something more. It’s truly a cute box, and I think it’s great for kids around 5-7, but it seems a bit “young” for kids much older than that.
label: neutral
